Problem

Given a string s, reverse the order of the words. A word is a sequence of non-space characters, and words are separated by at least one space.

Return a string of the words in reverse order, joined by a single space. The input may contain leading, trailing, or repeated spaces, which must not appear in the output.

Example

Input: s = "  the sky   is blue "
Output: "blue is sky the"

Constraints

  • 1 <= s.length <= 10^4, and s contains English letters, digits and spaces.

Your solution
